verdict.rationale: Termius provides interactive SSH terminal sessions, with one-click switching between terminal and SFTP for the same host and terminal cursor control on mobile. It also lets you save and run shell scripts as snippets, so remote editors and linters could in principle be run inside the app. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions using a terminal-based editor or running syntax/lint checkers, so support is only implied. Missing for 10: documented use of terminal editors (vim/nano) inside sessions, any mention of syntax or lint checking, built-in file editing, hands-on corroboration of editing workflows.
